idea: Coastal time, volcanic landscapes and marked walking trails.
caution: Mild coastal weather is not guaranteed swimming weather. Check trail difficulty and mountain conditions.

idea: Historic neighborhoods, Portuguese food and an optional Oceanário visit.
caution: Winter is a city break rather than a reliably hot beach escape. Surfing requires a coastal transfer.

idea: A Funchal base for gardens, local food and optional levada walks.
caution: Choose walks suitable for the youngest traveler. Check closures, reservations and changeable mountain weather.

idea: A Crete base for old-town walks, beaches and selected nature trails.
caution: Some gorge walks are strenuous or seasonal. Choose age-appropriate routes and verify access before visiting.

idea: Historic streets with island beach trips and countryside walks.
caution: Beach and walking areas need transfers from Valletta. Winter can be wet; check sea conditions and heat in summer.

idea: Coastal stays, archaeological discoveries and optional Akamas nature trails.
caution: Trail surfaces and distance vary. Choose a family-suitable walk and check access, heat and beach conditions.

idea: Atlantic beach time, family outings and guided Souss-Massa walks.
caution: The Atlantic may feel cool even on warm days. Nature trips and surf sites need transfers; match activities to age and ability.

idea: Family attractions, beach time and optional outdoor trips beyond the city.
caution: Hiking requires an out-of-city transfer and route checks. Avoid assuming desert activities suit young children; summer heat can limit outdoor plans.

idea: Beach bases, temple visits and guided nature outings.
caution: Warm does not mean dry: rain and sea conditions change by season. Surf and mountain outings need ability checks; allow time for long transfers.

idea: Coastal outings, family attractions and selected Table Mountain trails.
caution: Sea temperatures can be cold. Check trail safety, wind, local guidance and child suitability; do not assume a city safari is included.

idea: A Guanacaste beach base with nature outings and optional surf lessons.
caution: Wet-season rain, currents and nesting restrictions can affect plans. Nature areas need transfers; allow enough time for the journey.

idea: Temple districts, gardens, local food and optional nearby mountain walks.
caution: Summer can be hot and humid. Trail difficulty varies; allow transfer time and check current access and opening hours.

idea: Old-town food stops, the seafront and optional Riviera coastal walks.
caution: Many beaches are pebbly. Coastal paths can be uneven, so check access and suitability for children and pushchairs.
